crop.notes: Whole Wray's Column, both columns. Allen is mentioned only in the 'Two Champions Ran Saloons Here' item at the foot of the left column (crop-3).

ocr.notes: Left column is mostly right, but the first sentence is garbled by mixing in the right column's opening ('Time to Loosen Up'); the right column (baseball) is otherwise left out.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch's Wray's Column, on English boxer Seaman Watson being a bartender, noted that Mike McCoole and Tom Allen both held the heavyweight title while running saloons in St. Louis.

metadata.notes: No page image; date and paper could not be checked against a masthead.

facts.fact: Allen owned and operated a saloon in St. Louis while he held the heavyweight title and was still active in the ring

notes: Current title has a typo ('Wrav's'). The current summary describes only the Watson items and does not mention Allen.
